title: REStandard
tagline: Real Estate Standard: mint compliant stablecoins backed by verified real estate property.
description: Real Estate Standard (RES): Mint compliant stablecoins against verified property worldwide. Upload official docs → TLS Notary proof → OMI/Zillow valuation → instant RES (1:1 USD/EUR). Overcollateralized vaults to avoid volatility risk, Uniswap pools, owner redemption. Unlocks $300T illiquid real estate equity for DeFi. GENIUS/Clarity Act ready.
how_its_made:
RES combines TLS Notary for privacy-preserving property verification with OMI/Zillow oracles for automated real estate valuation, creating MakerDAO-style overcollateralized vaults on Base.

Tech Stack:
Frontend: Next.js + wagmi/viem + Tailwind
Vault: Solidity (ERC-4626 + custom liquidation)
Proof: TLS Notary SDK (catasto PDF → zk-proof)
Oracles: Openapi.it + OMI API (€/sqm per zona)
Infra: Vercel + Base + TheGraph (subgraph events)
